Senior Software Engineer, Ledger Platform

Brickyard Pay, Inc. | Remote (US) | Full-time

About Brickyard Pay

Brickyard Pay builds technology to increase access to the global economy. Its products include card processing for small sellers, a peer-to-peer payments app and pay-later checkout. Across those products, money moves constantly: card payments, transfers between people, instant deposits, payouts to sellers. Every one of those movements has to be recorded correctly, explainable later, and reconciled against the banks and networks that actually hold the funds.

About the team

The Ledger Platform team builds and runs the shared double-entry ledger that product teams use to record money movement. We own the services, data model and tooling that turn a payment event into balanced journal entries, keep balances correct under heavy concurrency, and give finance and compliance teams a trustworthy record. We work closely with payments, payouts, risk and accounting engineering.

We're a distributed team across US time zones. We write design docs before we build, run blameless postmortems, and share an on-call rotation that we work hard to keep quiet.

The role

We're looking for a senior backend engineer who has built or run ledger, payments or other correctness-critical financial systems, and who cares as much about how a system fails as how it works on a good day. You'll design and ship core ledger capabilities, lead migrations of product teams onto the platform, and raise the bar for reliability and auditability.

What you'll do

- Design, build and operate high-throughput services that record money movement as balanced, immutable journal entries
- Lead the migration of existing balance tracking onto the shared ledger, including backfills, dual-write periods and zero-downtime cutovers
- Build idempotency, ordering and exactly-once-effect guarantees into event-driven pipelines
- Develop reconciliation tooling that compares ledger state against bank, network and partner records and surfaces breaks quickly
- Partner with finance and accounting stakeholders to translate accounting requirements into system design
- Write and review technical designs; mentor engineers across the team
- Participate in an on-call rotation (currently one week in seven) and lead incident response and follow-ups for ledger services

What you'll bring

- 7+ years of professional backend software engineering experience
- Production experience with financial systems: ledgers, payments, payouts, billing or similar systems where correctness is non-negotiable
- Strong understanding of double-entry accounting concepts as they apply to software
- Deep experience with relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL or MySQL, including transactions, isolation levels, indexing and schema evolution at scale
- Experience with event streaming systems such as Kafka, and with designing for at-least-once delivery
- Proficiency in at least one of Go, Java or Kotlin
- A track record of leading large technical projects end to end, including migrations of live systems
- Clear written communication; you're comfortable explaining tradeoffs to engineers and non-engineers

Nice to have

- Experience with reconciliation against bank files (for example ACH or wire return files) or card network settlement data
- Experience running services on Kubernetes and a major cloud provider
- Contributions to open-source infrastructure or financial tooling
- Experience as a tech lead for a group of engineers

Compensation

The base salary range for this role in the US is $192,000 to $288,000, depending on location, level and experience. This role is also eligible for equity and a comprehensive benefits package including healthcare, retirement plans with company match, paid time off and family leave.

Location and travel

This role is remote within the United States. The team meets in person about twice a year; expect travel of less than 5%.

Work authorization

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This role does not require a security clearance.
